title: Finish a change with complete proof
steps: Capture required criteria and the requested finish level: Local / Commit / Push / PR.
Run required checks; match proof to the exact candidate identity.
Perform the authorized finish; inspect receipts and outcome.

complete_when: required acceptance, claims, landing equality and requested finish all have explicit matching facts (p.186).
traceability: p.186; controls V-07..V-12, O-06, B-04; acceptance A35, A36.
